newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bank Negara Indonesia Singapore branch sets FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Bank Negara Indonesia Singapore branch sets FRCD.

text.p: The following issue was announced on Tuesday by arranger Overseas Union Bank, Singapore branch.
BORROWER BANK NEGARA INDONESIA, SINGAPORE BRANCH
AMOUNT US$30 MLN COUPON 3 OR 6ML+40BP MATURITY 3 YRS
TYPE FRCD ISS PRICE PAR LAUNCH 19.NOV.96
PUTS NONE CALLS NONE REPLIES 1ST WK DEC
LISTING NONE REPAYMENT BULLET* DENOMS $250K
RATING NONE SALE LMTS CUSTOMARY TAX PROV --
NEG PLG -- CRS DEF -- FORCE MAJ --
HOME CTRY INDONESIA GOV LAW SINGAPORE PAY DATE --
MGT LEVELS AND FEES
CO-LEAD MANAGERS US$5 MLN+ 37.5 BP ALL-IN 52.5
MANAGERS US$2-4 MLN 30.0 BP ALL-IN 50.0
ARRANGER OVERSEAS UNION BANK, SINGAPORE BRANCH
CO-ARGRS JP MORGAN SECURITIES ASIA AND SANWA INTERNATIONAL
FINANCE
NOTES *THERE IS EARLY REDEMPTION IN THE EVENT THAT THE
REPUBLIC OF INDONESIA HOLDS LESS THAN 51 PCT
OF THE ISSUED CAPITAL OF THE BORROWER.
THIS ISSUE IS THE FIRST SYNDICATED FUNDRAISING FOR
THE SINGAPORE BRANCH.
-- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6960
